notes: The rules do not settle where the second branch («وحدثنا فضيل، عن هشام») ends: it names no transmitter after Hisham, and the saying follows the third branch («مخلد بن حسين ... محمد بن سيرين»). Each branch is read as written; for a ruling.
«هشام» stands three times; occurrences 1 to 3 are the three branches in text order. The archive flag («the same name stands twice») is the same point.
